recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. issue_request: FHIR-37802 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested references from DiagnosticReport and Observation to GenomicStudy. The final resolution added DiagnosticReport.study as Reference(ImagingStudy|GenomicStudy) and added GenomicStudy to Observation.partOf and Observation.derivedFrom.
initial_application: The R5 request was applied through the GenomicStudy PR/history trail: c408ff2 added GenomicStudy references to DiagnosticReport and Observation, 77cb02a renamed the DiagnosticReport element to study and added guidance, and 385f838 adjusted the wording. The current source retained some of that narrative after later commits removed direct GenomicStudy target profiles.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport and Observation are active in source/fhir.ini, but GenomicStudy has no active core fhir.ini entry. Later commits 3b38b80 and fad1b9c removed GenomicStudy from active core configuration and DiagnosticReport/Observation target profiles as part of moving additional resources to incubator IGs. FHIR-54164 and OO WGM minutes support removing stale GenomicStudy references/text after the move, and FHIR-57361 kept the generic study name for future extensibility while noting GenomicStudy moved to Incubator. FHIR-46394 was already represented on the combined branch and its supportingInfo target was later removed by the same incubator move.
reconciliation: Changed source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-introduction.xml so it no longer says genomic metadata is referenced through DiagnosticReport.study, and points to the Clinical Genomics incubator GenomicStudy resource instead. Changed source/observation/observation-notes.xml so it no longer says base Observation.partOf or Observation.derivedFrom directly reference GenomicStudy; it retains DocumentReference derivedFrom guidance and directs additional linkage patterns to the linked GenomicStudy guidance.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/diagnosticreport-introduction.xml: narrowed study guidance to diagnostic imaging studies, moved GenomicStudy wording to an external Clinical Genomics incubator reference, and made future non-imaging study targets explicitly future-version work.

source/observation/observation-notes.xml: removed direct base Observation.partOf/derivedFrom GenomicStudy guidance and clarified that base Observation does not include GenomicStudy as a direct target.
